title: EEG Decoding in Context: A Framework for Tuning-Free EEG Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.31171v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding is a central route toward brain-computer interfaces for communication, rehabilitation, cognitive assessment, and neurological monitoring. Recent EEG foundation models have substantially advanced reusable signal representations, but their downstream use still typically requires a task-specific decoder, gradient-based adaptation, and validation-driven model selection. We investigate a complementary foundation-model paradigm based on in-context learning: labeled EEG recordings define the decoding task as context, and new recordings are predicted without updating model parameters. We first pair raw EEG features with a pretrained general-purpose in-context predictor. This direct formulation provides a promising starting point, but its performance remains limited and unstable and does not generalize reliably across EEG paradigms. translated_title: 上下文中的脑电解码：免调优脑电基础模型框架
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）解码是实现用于通信、康复、认知评估和神经监测的脑机接口的核心途径。近期的脑电基础模型在很大程度上推进了可复用的信号表征，但其在下游任务中的使用通常仍需要任务特定的解码器、基于梯度的适配以及依赖验证集的模型选择。我们研究了一种基于上下文学习的互补性基础模型范式：带标签的脑电记录将解码任务定义为上下文，而对新记录的预测无需更新模型参数。我们首先将原始脑电特征与预训练的通用上下文预测器相结合。这种直接的方法提供了一个有前景的起点，但其性能仍然有限且不稳定，并且无法在脑电范式之间可靠地泛化。我们发现合适的上下文构建可以解决这些局限（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于上下文学习的免调优脑电基础模型框架，通过将带标签的脑电记录作为上下文来定义解码任务，无需更新模型参数即可完成对新脑电记录的解码预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an in-context learning framework for tuning-free EEG foundation models, where labeled EEG recordings serve as context to define the decoding task, enabling prediction on new recordings without updating model parameters.
